Type: traditional wood TV stand
Use: TV and media storage; living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: walnut-finish wood, raised panel doors, metal knobs
Colors: warm dark walnut brown, bronze
Shape: tall compact cabinet, two side raised-panel doors, central open shelves with arched top, drawer below, molded top and arched plinth base
Feel: cozy, homely, classic
Goes with: cream walls, dark wood, warm textiles; traditional or farmhouse rooms

product.name: ROCKPOINT TV Stand, 42x16x23.6inch, Walnut Brown
product.description: TV stand / media storage console in a traditional highboy style; ideal for a bedroom, living room, or game room Accommodates most flat-panel TVs up to 48 inches; supports up to 250 pounds Open storage space with adjustable-height shelf; bottom storage drawer; 2 side storage cabinets with swing-open doors High-grade MDF and durable laminate construction; rich, textured finish; ships ready to assemble (instructions included) Measures 16 by 42 by 32 inches (LxWxH); weighs 105 pounds
